title: I Replaced Figma + Adobe + Canva with 2 Free AI Tools #shorts #ai #design
hook: I cancelled Figma, Adobe, and Canva. Replaced them all with 2 free AI tools.
description:
I cancelled Figma, Adobe, and Canva. Replaced them all with 2 free AI tools.

Monthly cost dropped from 180 dollars to zero. The two tools: Flux on Pollinations for image generation, and Penpot for vector editing. Combined output replaces 90 percent of what I used the paid stack for.

In this video: side-by-side comparison, the only feature I lost, and when paid tools still win.

scenes.voiceover: I cancelled Figma, Adobe, and Canva. Replaced them all with 2 free AI tools. Monthly cost dropped from 180 dollars to zero.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand holding credit card next to laptop showing subscription cancellation screen, modern minimal desk setup, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: Tool one: Flux on Pollinations. Free, no signup, generates 1080p images from text prompts. Replaces my Canva template stack entirely.
scenes.visual_prompt: AI image generation interface on monitor showing prompt input and generated artwork, modern dark theme UI, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: Tool two: Penpot. Open source vector editor, runs in browser, exports SVG and PDF. Real collaboration like Figma without the price tag.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vector design software interface showing SVG editor with shapes and layers panel, modern UI design, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: Real test: I redesigned my product landing page in 47 minutes. Used Flux for hero images, Penpot for layout. Output looked premium.
scenes.visual_prompt: Modern SaaS landing page mockup on monitor with hero image and call to action button, clean minimalist design, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: The one thing I lost: Adobe's photo retouching for client work. For that I still use Krita, also free. So technically three tools, all zero cost.
scenes.visual_prompt: Photo editing software interface showing portrait retouching tools and layers panel, modern dark theme UI, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: When paid still wins: enterprise team sync at 50 plus seats, and Adobe's video editing. For solo creators, free stack is enough.
scenes.visual_prompt: Team collaboration in modern office with multiple screens showing design files, warm lighting, photorealistic

scenes.voiceover: What paid tool should I find a free replacement for next? Comment the subscription you want me to kill.
